speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis

Given your history of AIDS and recent treatment for fungal esophagitis, we must urgently rule out opportunistic infections like CMV, which is a common cause of retinitis in immunocompromised patients. I will now perform a dilated fundus examination to look for the characteristic "pizza-pie" retinal lesions. REQUEST IMAGES: Fundoscopy_Right_Eye
